# Claude Code Hooks Security Check

> Paste a Claude Code hooks configuration and see which command strings match known-dangerous shapes: a remote download piped straight into a shell, a credential file read and sent over the network, an unguarded recursive delete, TLS verification disabled, and more. Free, runs entirely in your browser, nothing uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
